I replied in #strategic-pod: the corrected Vantorre Group count you posted on 1 Jul at 09:19 was 280 seats.

Your 09:14 post said 300. You retracted it because that number included sandbox logins from the May rollout. The 280 was the production roster count as of 1 Jul, so it may be out of date for an October QBR.
